title: mimi-server: Room/update, send, unbind, GroupInfo and KeyMaterial fetch
description: Handlers for Room/update, Room/send, Room/unbind, GroupInfo/fetch, KeyMaterial/fetch with a hub-I/O backend trait that can return serverUnavailable (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 L226, L312-414).
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests quote L312-414; hub failure -> serverUnavailable (L226).
notes:
BLOCKED (agent, 2026-10-20): needs unlanded siblings. (1) crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server does not exist yet, and there is no openmls/tls_codec dep or MIMI-protocol TLS decoding (UpdateRequest, KeyMaterialRequest, GroupInfoRequest) in the workspace. (2) The L255 bind/unbind lifecycle that Room/unbind and the 'no Chat bound to roomId' checks (L226/L312/L351/L401) rely on is scoped to JMAP-6k5d.6. (3) The MUST-store-FanoutMessage-on-success rules (L334, L367) go through the .6 fanout store (L432-439). (4) KeyMaterial/fetch answers local users from the .3 claim store (L226). Suggested deps: .5 -> .4 (crate + room registry), .6, .3.
STILL BLOCKED (agent, 2026-10-20, spec 6bcd9d8): .3 (584e2d63) and .4 (1772b61c) landed, but .6 has not. All five handlers reject when 'no Chat in the account is bound to roomId' (mimi L231, L317, L356, L406), Room/unbind is the bind lifecycle (L260, L374-389), and Room/update / Room/send MUST store the FanoutMessage under L433-444 rules (L339, L372); the bound/unbound state and fanout store are .6 scope, and neither exists in MemoryBackend. Also needed here, not in .6: TLS decoding of KeyMaterialRequest/Response, UpdateRequest/Response, SubmitMessageResponse, GroupInfoRequest/Response (draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.2-5.6) and a hub-I/O trait. Dep .5 -> .6 added.
